content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set close to London's O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry, prompting the London fire brigade to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown shortly before eight p.m. on Saturday; after roughly an hour the flames were brought under control by twenty‑five firefighters with no injuries reported, and officials said the blaze followed a pre‑planned filming activity at the site, adding that crews would stay on scene for the rest of the evening while police noted reports of explosions heard near the venue.
